description: This notice serves as a follow-up to Sources Sought posting 36C10B26Q0056 and informs interested parties that, based on market research, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) intends to pursue a competitive acquisition on a full and open basis. The solicitation will be posted to SAM Contract Opportunities, under solicitation number 36C10B26R0006, with an estimated release date of March 24, 2026, subject to change.
